name: Nebula Hearts
source:
Awaken to chaos aboard a drifting spaceship, where you navigate playful banter with your quirky crew. Choose your words wisely and confront the unknown – will you forge bonds or reveal hidden secrets?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
在一艘漂流宇宙飞船上的混乱中醒来，与古怪的船员们进行有趣的玩笑。明智地选择你的言语并面对未知的事物——你会建立联系还是揭露隐藏的秘密？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
